evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official East Midlands Investment Zone tax-site page identifies Infinity Park as one of three designated tax sites, states that the designations took effect on 26 February 2025, and says the published tax-site map attachments show the exact locations. The Investment Zone (East Midlands) (Designation of Special Tax Sites) Regulations 2025 designate the area shown edged and hatched in red on the map entitled Infinity Park Derby Tax Site, dated 5 December 2024, as a special tax site with effect from 26 February 2025. The GOV.UK location note places Infinity Park about five miles south of Derby city centre, accessed from A50 junction 3, near the M1 and East Midlands Airport.
